messages:
Nina: heads-up — some routes showing much higher "net" savings than expected. looks like credits > gross for a few tenants.
Devon: ugh, saw tenant t-42 with negative billed tokens. likely double-applying prefetch + hotpath credits.
Sara: do we still only store daily aggregates? hard to debug w/o per-invocation info.
Nina: yeah. small proposal: emit one compact sampled event per invocation with fields: tenant_id, route, sku_id, gross_tokens, credit_tokens. 1% sample.
Devon: cardinality ok if sku_id is numeric and we don't include model names. add sampling_seed so samples are stable per-tenant.
Sara: for Console UX: default card = "billing net tokens". have a small chevron to expand to "gross + credits" stacked breakdown. keep default low-noise.
Nina: alerts: add rule when sampled extrapolation suggests credits > 40% of gross for a route. reduces surprise.
Devon: rollout: telemetry flag -> 1% sample -> canary 10 tenants -> beta UI -> optional backfill for beta.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled 2025-09-10T03:00:00Z
Sara: action: Devon will draft schema + storage estimate. Nina will mock UI. I'll handle RBAC for sku mapping.
Nina: thanks all, will open RFC later today :thumbsup:
